title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- PREPARED MEN

excerpt.rendered: “The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley…

content.rendered: “The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which was full of bones,” (Ezekiel 37: 1)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.The hand of the Lord was upon Ezekiel, and it carried him in the Spirit of the Lord to the valley which was full of dry bones. The processes that God took Ezekiel through were not for Ezekiel’s own enjoyment; there were dry bones that needed to be prophesied back to life. There was a hopeless situation which heaven wanted to use Ezekiel to reverse. God prepared Ezekiel in order to rescue the dry bones.Friend, sometimes when God wants to raise your ‘dry bones’ back to life, He prepares a man to come to your rescue. When God wants to announce and activate a new season for your destiny, He sends you a man. When God wants to rewrite the story of a man for good, He sends a helper of destiny. When God wants to prosper your business, He sends a man to make things happen. When God wants to move you higher, He sends a man to make it happen.Today, God is sending you men who will raise your ‘dry bones’ back to life. God is sending you men who will unlock your next level; God is sending you men who will push you to higher levels; God is sending you men who have the resources you need in order to arise and advance; God is sending you men who will turn around your fortunes for good; God is sending you men who will cause your business, career, ministry, etc to blossom.The men that will help you to become all that God has destined you to become are on the way. The men that will help you to rise higher and higher are on the way. The men that will open the doors you cannot open for yourself are on the way. The men that will fight the battles you cannot fight for yourself are on the way. The men that will speak for you in high places are on the way. The men God prepared for you are on the way.Receive your men that are on assignment in your life; receive the men that God has prepared for you.Isaiah 60: 10 says: “And the sons of strangers shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favour have I had mercy on thee.”Declare With Me: I receive the men that God has prepared for me; I receive help from high places, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
